items.prompt: After emitting the top row of a nonempty rectangle, the algorithm increments top. What must the bounds describe before the next side is read?

options.text: The original full grid including the emitted row.
options.why: Retaining the completed row as unvisited would allow duplicate emissions.

options.text: A sorted list of values still missing from the output.
options.why: Bounds represent coordinates, not sorted values or a frequency set.

options.text: Only the four corners of the original grid.
options.why: Interior rows and columns remain inside the unvisited rectangle too.

options.text: The remaining unvisited rectangle after that row is removed.
options.why: Shrinking the bound excludes all cells already emitted on that side.

items.explanation: Shrinking the bound excludes all cells already emitted on that side.
